profile.headline: Engineer at Netflix
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I have a strong background in Java, Python, numerous JS frameworks, AWS and microservices architecture. I enjoy working with diverse and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality products.

I am currently a Software Engineer at Netflix.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Backend lead on LinkedIn's Marketing Solutions (LMS) platform, working across ads infrastructure, AI-powered creative tooling, and content platforms serving LinkedIn's $15B+ feed advertising business. Previously led the Publishing and Newsletters backend team.

  - Led the sponsored ads tracking migration for SDUI (LinkedIn's next-gen feed), taking over as technical lead coordinating 8-10 engineers across four teams and building the ETL, dashboards, and daily reporting that became core infrastructure.
  - Technical lead for Gen-AI creative ads and brand tools, helping advertisers generate on-brand ads and laying the foundation for a $10M incremental revenue roadmap.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Backend lead in the Publishing team, in charge of the newsletter and long text content platform. These features are used weekly by companies and members such as Bill Gates or Wall Street Journal, and actively consumed by more than 700M subscribers.

  - Led a partnership with the revenue team to onboard newsletters and first party articles as sponsorable content, bringing +$10M in the first months.
  - Delivered initiatives responsible for a 10x increase in newsletter subscribers, such as enabling companies to create newsletters, building a follow-triggered subscription pipeline. Rebuilt notification fan-out from batch ETL to streaming, cutting delivery latency from >24h to <1min.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Part of the Commerce area, responsible for services with ~20 million requests per day that handle the end-to-end ticketing process flow.

* Ported core features from a Django monolith to a microservices architecture, refactoring and enhancing legacy logic that resolved in considerable performance and throughput improvements.
* Implemented a redeemable credits system through a cross international team collaboration that brought in about $500k revenue in its first weeks during the COVID-19 times.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Played an integral part of a full-stack application that forecasts advertising media plans for multi-million-dollar media companies, including Viacom and Fox.

* Developed backend microservices in Python/Flask that transformed and served data science outputs.
*  Significantly improved data scientist's performance by integrating complex predictive models with software solutions as AWS Services, Airflow and RabbitMQ.
* Contributed to frontend tasks writing Vue.js+Vuex components, as an authentication Auth0 flow, data D3.js representation, and SocketIO real-time events.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Engineer in Comcast’s Advanced Advertising group. Responsible for building internal tools, APIs, and libraries to increase reliability, maintainability, and productivity of multiple engineering departments.

* Built APIs using Flask, Celery, and Redis used to orchestrate internal environment management.
* Developed common Python libraries used by multiple engineering departments managing programmatic Docker container creation and Database connection handling.
* Led efforts to move a MSSQL reporting system to run on Linux by developing custom Python frameworks to manage workflow.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for packaging open source and commercial applications into deployable stacks out of the box for easy use on all major cloud service providers.

* Created internal NodeJS services that performed automatic compilation and packaging of the Bitnami application stacks.
* Employed Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS to deploy stacks.
* Automated the testing, building and releasing process utilizing Jenkins.
* Point of contact for some ISV clients such as eXo Platform Enterprise. Managed their application automation and deployment optimizing its performance.

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
University library technology department intern. Collaborated creating web services that were used daily by college students and teachers.

* Developed a full stack web application for the management of library reservation and holds.
* Built a Java service that displayed reporting data and monitoring from the logs of DSpace, a library open source application.
* Managed Linux servers scheduling backup tasks and enhancing security.

projects.title: Web service deployment on the cloud using Docker containers
projects.description: During this project a medical web application is deployed using Docker containers, Azure cloud instances and Kubernetes leaving behind the previous model of a monolithic virtual machine. This approach will bring new features and options that would have been impossible using a traditional deployment.
